<thought>We need to determine how many methyl (CH₃) groups are present in the unknown compound. The most direct way is to obtain the 13C NMR spectrum, where each methyl carbon appears as a distinct signal typically in the 10‑30 ppm region. By counting those signals we can answer the question without additional experiments.</thought>
